stories.title: PDF Inline Viewer
stories.description: View PDF inline without downloading. Basic zoom and page navigation.
acceptance_criteria: PDF renders inline on version detail view
Basic zoom controls (fit width, zoom in/out)
Page navigation for multi-page PDFs
Download button still available

stories.title: Version Assignment
stories.description: Assign a version to a specific user to indicate it's their turn to act.
acceptance_criteria: Admin can assign version to any user
Assigned user shown on version card
Dashboard shows 'attention required' indicator for assigned items
Activity log entry on assignment change

stories.title: Item-Level Change Tracking
stories.description: Track specific item changes (e.g., price changes) within a version.
acceptance_criteria: Add item changes when creating version (item name, old value, new value)
Display item changes on version detail
Optional - can create version without item changes

stories.title: Version Tree Visualization
stories.description: Visual tree showing version history with branching.
acceptance_criteria: Tree/timeline view of all versions for a menu
Status color-coded nodes
Clear live version indicator
Click node to see version details

stories.title: Branch Creation
stories.description: Create new version branching from any existing version.
acceptance_criteria: Create new version from specific parent (not just latest)
Parent version reference stored and displayed
Branch shown in version tree

stories.title: Version Comments
stories.description: Add comments to versions with category tagging.
acceptance_criteria: Add comment to a version with text content
Select comment category (Content, Design, Pricing, Other)
Display comments list on version detail page
Show comment author, timestamp, and category

stories.title: @Mentions in Comments
stories.description: Tag users in comments with autocomplete.
acceptance_criteria: Type @ to trigger user autocomplete in comment input
Select user from dropdown to insert mention
Mentions stored in comment_mentions table
Mentioned usernames highlighted in comment display

stories.title: Activity Log UI
stories.description: View activity history for menus and versions.
acceptance_criteria: Activity log page showing recent actions
Filter by action type (status changes, comments, uploads)
Show user, action, target, and timestamp
Link to related version/menu from activity item

stories.title: Dashboard Search and Filter
stories.description: Search and filter menus on dashboard.
acceptance_criteria: Search menus by name
Filter by category
Filter by current status
Clear filters button
